search_and_comparison.setting_limit: At most 45 settings total across Goal 7 rounds 1 and 2, unless Griffin changes the limit at the Goal 5 check-in.
search_and_comparison.setting_count_scope: Running count of distinct settings covers Goals 5, 6, and 7; Goals 10 and 11 are listed separately.
search_and_comparison.source: CODEX_GOALS.md, Definitions used in every goal; Goal 7

seeds_and_budget.practice_budget: Each setting/experiment gets its own maximum 200 learned-from practice episodes; fill-up episodes count. Do not use confirmation seeds before the choice is written down.
seeds_and_budget.outcome_point: Use the result at episode 200, never the best point along the learning curve.
seeds_and_budget.source: CODEX_GOALS.md, Definitions used in every goal; Goal 7

selection_rule: Choose highest average success on development test seed 123.
Among settings within one spread of the top average, choose the setting with fewest changes from the main experiment; if still tied, choose the higher average.
If no round 1 change beats the main experiment by more than one spread, skip round 2 and confirm the main experiment.
Mark differences smaller than seed-to-seed spread as not a real difference.
Write the selected setting and reason before any confirmation run.

plain-setting both-together Goal 6 learner on the same confirmation seeds
plain-setting aim-only Goal 5 learner on the same confirmation seeds

show settings tried next to each method
confirmation_comparisons.ambiguity: The 'three Goal 6 learners' wording includes aim-only, movement-only, and both-together, although aim-only originates in Goal 5; interpreted as the three learner types in the Goal 6 comparison and cross-referenced to Goal 5 for aim-only.

exact_ambiguities_for_lead: Goal 7 says at most 45 settings across rounds 1 and 2, while the global definition counts settings across Goals 5, 6, and 7; the text does not say whether the 45 cap includes the reused baseline or Goal 5/6 settings.
Numeric values are unspecified for several qualitative changes (and many parameter sweeps); the goals require sensible choices to be logged, while no values are supplied here.
Goal 7 says 'three Goal 6 learners' at confirmation, but Goal 6's list has aim-only reused from Goal 5 plus movement-only and both-together; treated as the three compared learner types.
